build_reslayer_backbone: build a ResLayer with BasicBlock for a ResNet style backbone with 3 blocks
create_reslayer_with_avgpool: create a ResLayer using avg_down for downsampling instead of stride convolution
build_reslayer_multigrid: build a ResLayer with multi_grid dilation rates for the last stage blocks
create_reslayer_with_custom_norm: create a ResLayer with custom normalization config using GroupNorm instead of BatchNorm
test_reslayer_forward: test the ResLayer forward pass by passing a tensor through the sequential blocks
